about_the_game:
"Dogma" is a first-person Chinese horror game blending rule-based anomalies with Yin-Yang realms. As the sole survivor of a cursed household, you return to the isolated ancestral mansion, following cryptic family precepts to reconstruct memories through four relatives' perspectives, revealing truths buried between dreams and reality.

Amidst millennial chaos, a family of four descends into madness. Twenty years later, as the escaped younger brother, you receive your mother's letter summoning you back to the derelict home. Navigating spaces where supernatural phenomena intertwine with fragmented memories, you must uncover mold-covered secrets through stealth, artifact collection, and paranormal chases.

Gameplay requires obeying paradoxical family rules while traversing dual realms, solving environmental puzzles, and confronting haunting truths about sacrificial rituals that shattered your bloodline at the turn of the century.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

Minimum:

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or Intel Core i5 4590 or equivalent (or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD R9 280 or NVIDIA GTX 960 or equivalent (or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: "Dogma": A first-person Chinese horror game where you return to a decaying ancestral home to decipher cryptic family rules. Shift between realms, evade spirits, and collect cursed relics to uncover a millennium-era family tragedy. Choose redemption or destruction at the Yin-Yang threshold.
